<!-- 说明「你想做什么」比说明「该怎么做」更有用 —— 实现方式留给我。 -->
<!-- What you want to do matters more than how to build it — leave the implementation to me. -->

**想要的功能 / What you want**

**使用场景 / Why**

<!-- 现在是怎么凑合的？这一步最能说明值不值得做。 -->
<!-- How do you work around it today? That tells me whether it is worth building. -->

**备选方案 / Alternatives**

**补充 / Anything else**
